sentences.text: This petition was called on for hearing today.

CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.R. SHAH  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C.T. RAVIKUMAR  For Petitioner(s) Mr. Neeraj Kumar Jain, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Umang Shankar, AOR  Mr. Aniket Jain, Adv.
 Mr. Sanjay Singh, Adv.
 Mr. Praveen Alok, Adv.
 For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present Special Leave Petition unconditionally as the petitioner proposes to make a representation to the State Government for release of the land under Section 101A of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

Without expressing anything on merits on such representation and/or entertainability and/or maintainability of such representation, we simply permit the petitioner to withdraw the present Special leave Petition.
The present Special Leave Petition stands dismissed as withdrawn.
